intent: Show a short line above the title, typically a link to the parent the page belongs to.
typical_uses: A link to the list or the parent a page belongs to, above the object's name

dont_use_when.situation: A full trail of links to every page above the current one

invariants.text: PageHeaderEyebrow sets the meta role (12/16) in --muted-foreground on one line, truncated with an ellipsis, var(--space-1) above the title. It holds text or a plain link - a link inside takes its colour, turns --link-foreground with an underline on hover, and draws its focus ring inside its own box, where the eyebrow's clipping cannot cut it - and no Breadcrumb trail.

anti_patterns.dont: Describe the page above its title
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put the description under the title, in PageHeaderDescription

good.title: A link to the parent list

bad.title: The page's description set above the title
bad.why: The eyebrow places the page among its parents and is read before the title; a sentence about the page reads after the title, in PageHeaderDescription.
